card.name: Start of adverse-event sentences
card.fires_on: The first word of a new sentence that reports an adverse event, often a capital N starting Nephrotic, Nephritis or Nausea. It also fires on verbs like occurred and reported right after an event name and before a percentage.

modes.label: Capital N opening a sentence
modes.description: The letter N starts a sentence naming a kidney or nausea event, right after a period.
modes.example: 3 patients who reinitiated bevacizumab, 48% experienced a second episode of Grades 2 to 4 proteinuria.<< N>>ephrotic syndrome occurred in <1

modes.label: Reporting verb before a percentage
modes.description: Occurred or reported follows an event or patient group, just before a rate.
modes.example: CAPItello-291 Diarrhea<< occurred>> in 72% of patients.

modes.label: Of after data-set noun
modes.description: The word of in a description of a records data set, outside drug text.
